catalog.name: Telegram
catalog.description: Let the agent read and reply in Telegram chats — and wake it when someone messages or @mentions it.
catalog.hint: One token from @BotFather is the whole setup — no app review, no public URL. In GROUPS a bot sees only messages that @mention it until you turn privacy mode off (`/setprivacy` → Disable), which is the same trade-off as Discord's Message Content intent: hear everything, or only what is addressed to you.

steps: Message `@BotFather` and send `/newbot`, then pick a display name and a username ending in `bot`.
Copy the HTTP API token it hands back and paste it here.
For a group: add the bot to it, then `/setprivacy` → your bot → `Disable` if it should read every message rather than only @mentions.
Say hello to the bot in Telegram — it answers from the first message, no invite step.
